map.由局部阻力系数与流速，按 h_L = K·v²/(2g) 计算阀门、弯头等局部水: Compute local head loss h_L = K*v^2/(2g) for valves, elbows and fittings from the loss coefficient K and velocity.
map.K 典型值：90°弯头≈0.3–0.9，全开闸阀≈0.2，突然扩大按公式单独算。: Typical K values: 90° elbow ≈0.3–0.9, fully open gate valve ≈0.2, sudden expansion computed separately by formula.
map.弯头、阀门、变径的局部损失估算。: Local loss estimate for elbows, valves and reducers.
map.短管系统损失占比核算。: Loss proportion check for short-pipe systems.
map.优化管件布置降损。: Optimize fitting layout to reduce loss.
map.ξ=0.5、v=3 → h_L=0.5×3²/(2×9.81)=0.229 m；: ξ=0.5, v=3 → h_L=0.5×3²/(2×9.81)=0.229 m; sum losses of multiple fittings.
map.全开闸阀 ξ≈0.2，半开骤增到数，局部损失可超沿程，应避免节流运行。: Fully open gate valve ξ≈0.2; half open jumps to several, local loss can exceed friction loss, so throttling should be avoided.
map.由管件型式查局部阻力系数表，弯头/阀门/进出口各异。: Look up the local loss coefficient table by fitting type; elbows/valves/inlets-outlets differ.
map.总水头损失=沿程+Σ局部，短管局部常占主导。: Total head loss = friction + Σ local; local loss often dominates in short pipes.
